body.text: This is the last letter I shall send you from {param:town}, and I send it because you are owed it and not because I am obliged.
The town has declared. It was not a thing I did and it was not a thing I could have stopped by the time I understood it was coming. The men who came to the hall were not a mob. They had a list.
I have not been harmed. I do not think I shall be. They have been careful to be civil with me, which I find I mind more than if they had not been.
You will want to know what is to be done. I am no longer the man to ask.
